## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

✅ **Gate recommendation: approve.**

The new mapping matches Cohere’s 1536-dimensional default. The regression test covers the previous rejection, and the existing v3 default stays unchanged.

**Documentation:** Add `embed-v4.0` and its 1536-dimensional default to the supported-model lists in the [class docstring](https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/blob/84daa08a49f6ab8b81de079a1cc55b6886755c3f/python/python/lancedb/embeddings/cohere.py#L26) and [Cohere guide](https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/blob/84daa08a49f6ab8b81de079a1cc55b6886755c3f/docs/web/integrations/embedding/cohere.mdx#L15), including the guide’s `name` parameter description.

✅ **Gate recommendation: approve.**

The 1536-dimensional mapping matches Cohere’s default and preserves the existing v3 default. The guide and API docstring now consistently document `embed-v4.0` and its default dimension, addressing the earlier documentation suggestion.
